# Error codes

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../sdk/index.md).

:::

Every error is an [`ObolError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolError) with a stable `code` (API errors are [`ObolApiError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolApiError), a subclass with the HTTP fields), a
`message` (not normative), an optional `hint` and `cause`, and the extra fields listed, in `details`. Findings
(`Prepared.checks`, or `issues` in a result) have a `code`, a `severity` and, when they are about one item, a stable
`subject` (`{ pubkey }`, `{ address }` or `{ index }`). "2.15" names the 2.15 code or class that had the same meaning;
codes are reused where the meaning is the same.

In TypeScript the codes are the [`ObolErrorCode`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolErrorCode) and [`FindingCode`](./reference/types/send.md#FindingCode) unions (`OBOL_ERROR_CODES`, `FINDING_CODES` at
runtime) and [`ObolErrorDetails`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolErrorDetails) types the fields of each code; `isObolError(error, code)` narrows `details`.
`test/spec/conformance.spec.ts` checks that the codes below, those unions and the codes used in `src/` are the same
set.

**Naming.** A code names its subject first, then the condition: [`DEFINITION_INVALID`](./errors.md#DEFINITION_INVALID), [`OVM_READ_FAILED`](./errors.md#OVM_READ_FAILED),
[`SPLIT_PARAMS_REQUIRED`](./errors.md#SPLIT_PARAMS_REQUIRED). 3.0.0-rc.4 renamed the codes that did not follow it (`INVALID_BASE_URL` →
[`BASE_URL_INVALID`](./errors.md#BASE_URL_INVALID), `NOT_AN_OPERATOR` → [`ACCOUNT_NOT_OPERATOR`](./errors.md#ACCOUNT_NOT_OPERATOR), `NOT_OVM_OWNER` → [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](./errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED),
`ROLE_TO_PUBLIC_FORWARDER` → [`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](./errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER), `OWNER_TO_PUBLIC_FORWARDER` → [`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](./errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER),
`RECIPIENT_IS_PUBLIC_FORWARDER` → [`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT`](./errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT), `INVALID_INCENTIVES_DATA` → [`INCENTIVES_DATA_INVALID`](./warnings.md#INCENTIVES_DATA_INVALID),
`UNKNOWN_DISTRIBUTOR` → [`DISTRIBUTOR_UNKNOWN`](./warnings.md#DISTRIBUTOR_UNKNOWN), `UNEXPECTED_TOKEN` → [`TOKEN_MISMATCH`](./warnings.md#TOKEN_MISMATCH), `INVALID_PROOF` →
[`PROOF_INVALID`](./warnings.md#PROOF_INVALID), `EXIT_EPOCH_REGRESSION` → [`EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH`](./errors.md#EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH)); the CHANGELOG lists every rename and removal.

Operation names refer to [`operations.md`](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md).

```ts
import { isObolError } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

declare const run: () => Promise<unknown>;
try {
  await run();
} catch (error) {
  if (isObolError(error, 'DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED')) {
    console.log(error.details.available); // typed per code
  } else if (isObolError(error)) {
    console.log(error.code, error.hint);
  } else throw error;
}
```

## Checks every operation runs {#checks-every-operation-runs}

Not repeated below:

- **G1** Inputs are decoded against the operation's schema: required fields, types, hex lengths, address format
  (checksum rule in README), integer ranges. Failure: [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) with `issues[]` (path + message).
  (2.15 `PayloadValidationError`, `InvalidArgumentError`)
  Caller-supplied inputs and options are strict (3.0.0-rc.12): a key the operation does not define is
  [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) with `issue: "unknown_key"` and a message naming the key and the allowed keys, never ignored (a
  misspelt `signatures` would otherwise turn a check off). This covers every `prepare*` input, every options object
  (`verifyLock`, `isValidLock`, `fromLock`, `assertDepositData`, `status`, `verifyDefinition`, `watch`, `simulate`,
  `send`, [`ovm.getProvenance`](./reference/ovm.md#getProvenance), `blsVerify`), the top-level keys of [`exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) / [`exits.aggregate`](./reference/exits.md#aggregate) and the
  `createObolClient` config. Documents stay tolerant of extra fields: cluster definitions and locks, [`Deposit`](./reference/types/core.md#Deposit)
  objects, split params, and the API wire objects of exits (`cluster`, `payload`, `existing`, `validator`, `exit`),
  as do Obol API and beacon node responses.
- **G2** A `chain` or `api+chain` operation that reads contracts requires the client chain to have them: OVM, splits,
  incentives and deposit operations are mainnet (1) and Hoodi (560048) only. Else [`UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](./errors.md#UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN). (2.15)
- **G3** An operation that signs, or `send`, checks the `walletClient` chain equals the client chain, else
  [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](./errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH); no wallet: [`WALLET_REQUIRED`](./errors.md#WALLET_REQUIRED). (2.15 `assertSignerChain`, `SignerRequiredError`)
- **G4** An `api` operation with `api: false` throws [`API_DISABLED`](./errors.md#API_DISABLED). API failures map to the `API_*` codes.

## Input, client and chain {#section-input-client-and-chain}

### PAYLOAD_INVALID {#PAYLOAD_INVALID}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">G1: every operation</span></div>

An input failed its schema: missing field, wrong type or length, bad address or checksum, out-of-range integer, share sum; or, since 3.0.0-rc.12, a key the operation does not know in a caller-supplied input or options object (`issue: "unknown_key"`, the message names the key and the allowed keys; documents such as cluster files, deposits and API wire objects may carry extra fields). Fields: `issues: { path, message, issue? }[]`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | every operation (G1) |
| Caller should | fix the listed fields |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ issues: <a href="./reference/types/core#Issue">Issue</a>[] }</span> |
| In 2.x | [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) (`PayloadValidationError`); also replaces `INVALID_ARGUMENT` (`InvalidArgumentError`, one issue with the argument's path) |

</div>

### UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN {#UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">G2: every operation</span></div>

The chain is not supported at all, or not for this operation (contracts only on mainnet and Hoodi), or a pure check needs a fork version the SDK does not know. Fields: `chainId`, `operation`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | `createObolClient`, G2, `assertDepositData`, [`exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | use mainnet or Hoodi |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ chainId: number &#124; null; operation?: string }</span> |
| In 2.x | `UnsupportedChainError` (no code) |

</div>

### CHAIN_MISMATCH {#CHAIN_MISMATCH}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">G3: every operation</span></div>

`publicClient`, `walletClient` or a [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared) is on another chain than the client. Fields: `expectedChainId`, `actualChainId`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | `createObolClient`, every signing operation, `send` |
| Caller should | switch the wallet's chain, or build the client for the wallet's chain |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ expectedChainId: number; actualChainId: number }</span> |
| In 2.x | [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](./errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH) |

</div>

### WALLET_REQUIRED {#WALLET_REQUIRED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">G3: every operation</span></div>

The operation signs or sends and the client has no `walletClient` (or no account).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`cluster.create`](./reference/cluster.md#create), [`cluster.accept`](./reference/cluster.md#accept), `terms.*`, `send` |
| Caller should | pass a `walletClient` |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">Record&lt;string, never&gt;</span> |
| In 2.x | `SignerRequiredError` (no code) |

</div>

### BASE_URL_INVALID {#BASE_URL_INVALID}

`api.baseUrl` is not an Obol API host.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`createObolClient`](./reference/client.md#createObolClient) |
| Caller should | use one of the allowed base URLs, or `api: false` |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ baseUrl: string }</span> |
| In 2.x | `InvalidBaseUrlError` (no code) |

</div>

### API_DISABLED {#API_DISABLED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">G4: every operation</span></div>

An `api` operation was called with `api: false`. Fields: `operation`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | `api` operations; [`deposits.status`](./reference/deposits.md#status) without `beaconUrl` |
| Caller should | enable the API, or use the chain-only operation |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ operation?: string }</span> |
| In 2.x | new |

</div>

### CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE {#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE}

A contract the operation calls has no code or not the expected code (factory, Multicall3, batch deposit, OVM target). Fields: `address`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.setup.prepareCreateOvm`](./reference/setup.md#prepareCreateOvm), [`obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits`](./reference/setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits), [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit), [`obol.splits.prepareCreateSplit`](./reference/splits.md#prepareCreateSplit), [`obol.experimental.legacy.getOwrTranches`](./reference/experimental.md#legacy-getOwrTranches) |
| Caller should | check the chain; contact Obol if it persists |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ address: Address }</span> |
| In 2.x | plain `Error` ("Required factory contracts are not available") |

</div>

### CHAIN_READ_FAILED {#CHAIN_READ_FAILED}

A chain read needed for a check failed (RPC error, call reverted where it must not). Fields: `what`.

### ABORTED {#ABORTED}

The `signal` passed in the options was aborted; the run stopped at the next yield point. `cause` is the signal's `reason` (a `TimeoutError` `DOMException` for `AbortSignal.timeout`). Fields: `operation`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.cluster.verifyLock`](./reference/cluster.md#verifyLock), [`obol.cluster.isValidLock`](./reference/cluster.md#isValidLock), [`obol.deposits.assertDepositData`](./reference/deposits.md#assertDepositData) |
| Caller should | treat as the caller's own deadline or cancellation (a server: 503 / 408, not a verdict on the input) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ operation: string }</span> |
| In 2.x | new (2.15 `ClusterLockValidationTimeoutError`) |

</div>

## Obol API {#section-obol-api}

All carry `status`, `endpoint`, `method`, `body`, and `requestId` when the response has an `X-Request-Id` (also in the
message; quote it when reporting a problem). `API_*` errors only describe the HTTP exchange; a 2xx answer that
fails a local check raises the check's own code.

### API_VALIDATION {#API_VALIDATION}

400 / 422: the API rejected the request.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | any operation that calls the Obol API (G4) |
| Caller should | fix the request per the API message |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./reference/types/core#ApiErrorDetails">ApiErrorDetails</a></span> |
| In 2.x | `ValidationError` |

</div>

### API_UNAUTHORIZED {#API_UNAUTHORIZED}

401 / 403: signature or address not accepted; also terms not accepted.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | any operation that calls the Obol API (G4) |
| Caller should | check the wallet, chain and [`terms.accept`](./reference/terms.md#accept) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./reference/types/core#ApiErrorDetails">ApiErrorDetails</a></span> |
| In 2.x | `UnauthorizedError` |

</div>

### API_NOT_FOUND {#API_NOT_FOUND}

404.

## Cluster {#section-cluster}

2.15's `ClusterLockValidationTimeoutError` and `ClusterLockValidationBusyError` have no v3 code: `verifyLock` runs
on the calling thread with no workers, time limit or concurrency limit, and yields to the event loop (`yieldMs`). A
server that needs a deadline passes `signal` (e.g. `AbortSignal.timeout(ms)`): the run stops at the next yield point
with [`ABORTED`](./errors.md#ABORTED), which bounds the CPU spent per request; a concurrency limit it applies around the call.

### DEFINITION_INVALID {#DEFINITION_INVALID}

A definition failed `verifyDefinition`: config hash mismatch, wrong `fork_version`, unsupported version, invalid or unverifiable signature, or a conflicting `version` input. Fields: `issues: { code, message }[]` (`config_hash_mismatch`, `fork_version_mismatch`, `version_unsupported`, `version_mismatch`, `signature_invalid`, `signature_unverifiable`: a signature that does not recover to its signer, checked with no public client for the chain, so a contract wallet could not be asked).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.cluster.computeConfigHash`](./reference/cluster.md#computeConfigHash), [`obol.cluster.computeLockHash`](./reference/cluster.md#computeLockHash), [`obol.cluster.create`](./reference/cluster.md#create), [`obol.cluster.accept`](./reference/cluster.md#accept), [`obol.cluster.verifyDefinition`](./reference/cluster.md#verifyDefinition) |
| Caller should | do not sign it; check the config hash and the client chain |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ issues: Array&lt;{ code: string; message: string }&gt;; }</span> |
| In 2.x | `DEFINITION_VERIFICATION_FAILED` (`DefinitionVerificationError`) |

</div>

The wallet account is not an operator of the definition. Fields: `address`, `configHash`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |

| In 2.x | [`ACCOUNT_NOT_OPERATOR`](./errors.md#ACCOUNT_NOT_OPERATOR) |

</div>

### LOCK_INVALID {#LOCK_INVALID}

A lock failed `verifyLock` (see its steps; `definition_signature_unverifiable` means a definition signature could not be checked for lack of a public client on the lock's chain, see `verifyDefinition` "Contract-wallet signatures"; `definition_invalid` covers an unknown fork version, `num_validators` other than the number of validators and `deposit_amounts` outside Charon's rules) or its deposit data is malformed. Fields: `step` and `issue` (see `verifyLock`), with `index` for a per-validator step; or `issue` (`deposit_data_missing`, `deposit_data_invalid`, `partial_deposit_data_unexpected`, `fork_version_mismatch`) and `index`.

|---|---|

| Caller should | do not deposit; report the lock |

| In 2.x | plain `Error` ("Cluster lock failed validation", "Invalid deposit data for validator N") |

</div>

### DEPOSIT_CONFLICT {#DEPOSIT_CONFLICT}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

The pubkey already has other withdrawal credentials than the deposit's, so the ETH would follow those. Either (`existing: "queued"`) a pending deposit for the pubkey has different or unknown withdrawal credentials; the first processed deposit with a valid signature fixes them (deposits the Obol API found invalidly signed are skipped; on `credentialsConflict`, only the first validly signed one counts). Or (`existing: "validator"`, since 3.0.0-rc.12) `kind: "deposit"` for a pubkey that is already in the validator registry, in any status, whose credentials are not `0x01` / `0x02` credentials of the expected withdrawal address (or could not be read): the deposit would be a top-up of someone else's validator. This is the deposit front-running case. Fields: `index`, `pubkey`, `existingCredentials?`, `existing`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| Caller should | do not send; find out who made the other deposit; do not use this deposit data |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ index: number; pubkey: Hex; existingCredentials?: Hex; existing?: 'validator' &#124; 'queued'; }</span> |
| In 2.x | 2.16 `DepositConflictError` |

</div>

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

`kind: "deposit"` for a pubkey that is already in the validator registry (any status, exited included) with credentials of the expected withdrawal address. | In 2.x | new |

### STATUS_UNAVAILABLE {#STATUS_UNAVAILABLE}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

The deposit status source failed, or answered incompletely or malformed. Also the Obol API without `POST /v1/validators/:network/deposit-status` (404) and neither `lockHash` nor `beaconUrl` given: `reason: "endpoint_unavailable"` (writes then skip the status checks, as with no source). And, from `prepareDeposit`, a queue-only pubkey whose queued deposit signatures the API was still checking after the retries, with an unchecked deposit before the first validly signed one: `reason: "signatures_pending"`, `pubkey` (its credentials are not known yet; once decided, the write proceeds). And, since 3.0.0-rc.12, a beacon node (`beaconUrl`) that must not be trusted: `reason: "beacon_wrong_chain"` (its genesis validators root is not the client chain's), `"beacon_syncing"` (`is_syncing` or `el_offline`), `"beacon_optimistic"` (`is_optimistic`, or an `execution_optimistic` answer); none of its state is read.

| Caller should | retry; do not assume `new`; for `endpoint_unavailable`, pass `lockHash` or `beaconUrl`; for `signatures_pending`, retry in a slot or two; for `beacon_*`, use a synced beacon node of the client's chain |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ reason?: &#124; 'endpoint_unavailable' &#124; 'signatures_pending' &#124; 'beacon_wrong_chain' &#124; 'beacon_syncing' &#124; 'beacon_optimistic'; pubkey?: Hex; }</span> |
| In 2.x | 2.16 plain `Error` ("Malformed …") |

</div>

## Withdrawal and consolidation requests {#section-withdrawal-and-consolidation-requests}

The beacon chain ignores an execution-layer request that breaks one of its rules (Electra `process_withdrawal_request`,
EIP-7002; `process_consolidation_request`, EIP-7251) and keeps the fee, so each rule the status source lets the SDK
check is a blocking error. Every one carries `pubkey`. Without the data for a rule the SDK adds
[`VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED`](./warnings.md#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED) (a warning) instead. All new in 3.0.0-rc.4 (rc.3 had some of them as warnings).

### VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE {#VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE}

The validator is not in the registry or not active yet. Fields: `status`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | wait for activation, or drop the request (rc.3 warning `WITHDRAW_VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE`) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { status: string }</span> |

</div>

### VALIDATOR_EXITING {#VALIDATOR_EXITING}

The validator's exit is initiated (`exit_epoch` set), or it has exited. Fields: `exitEpoch`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | drop the request |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { exitEpoch: bigint }</span> |

</div>

### VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW {#VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW}

Fewer than 256 epochs (`SHARD_COMMITTEE_PERIOD`, about 27 h) since activation. Fields: `activationEpoch`, `eligibleEpoch`, `currentEpoch`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | wait until `eligibleEpoch` |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { activationEpoch: bigint; eligibleEpoch: bigint; currentEpoch: bigint; }</span> |

</div>

### CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE {#CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE}

The validator's withdrawal credentials are not `0x01` / `0x02` credentials of the address that sends the request (the OVM; the sender for a direct request; the OVM for a consolidation source). Fields: `withdrawalCredentials`, `source`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | send from the address the credentials point at (rc.3 warnings `WITHDRAW_CREDENTIALS_NOT_OVM`, `WITHDRAW_CREDENTIALS_NOT_SENDER`) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { withdrawalCredentials: Hex; source: Address; }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL {#EXIT_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL}

A full exit while partial withdrawals are pending for the validator (including partials earlier in the same transaction). Fields: `pendingPartialWithdrawals`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | wait for them to be processed |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { pendingPartialWithdrawals: bigint; }</span> |

</div>

### PARTIAL_REQUIRES_COMPOUNDING {#PARTIAL_REQUIRES_COMPOUNDING}

A partial withdrawal for a validator without `0x02` credentials. Fields: `withdrawalCredentials`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | consolidate to `0x02` first (source = target), or exit (rc.3 warning `WITHDRAW_PARTIAL_REQUIRES_COMPOUNDING`) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { withdrawalCredentials: Hex; }</span> |

</div>

### EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_TOO_LOW {#EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_TOO_LOW}

A partial withdrawal with an effective balance below 32 ETH. Fields: `effectiveBalance`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |

| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { effectiveBalance: bigint }</span> |

### NO_EXCESS_BALANCE {#NO_EXCESS_BALANCE}

A partial withdrawal while the balance is not above 32 ETH plus the pending partial withdrawals, or exceeds it by less than 1 gwei (the capped amount would be 0, which the beacon chain reads as a full exit). Fields: `balance`, `pendingPartialWithdrawals`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| Caller should | drop the request |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { balance: bigint; pendingPartialWithdrawals: bigint; }</span> |

</div>

### CONSOLIDATION_TARGET_NOT_COMPOUNDING {#CONSOLIDATION_TARGET_NOT_COMPOUNDING}

The target of a consolidation (source ≠ target) does not have `0x02` credentials. Fields: `withdrawalCredentials`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate) |
| Caller should | switch the target to `0x02` first (rc.3 warning) |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { withdrawalCredentials: Hex; }</span> |

</div>

### CONSOLIDATION_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL {#CONSOLIDATION_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL}

The source has pending partial withdrawals. Fields: `pendingPartialWithdrawals`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate) |
| Caller should | wait for them to be processed |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails &amp; { pendingPartialWithdrawals: bigint; }</span> |

</div>

### CONSOLIDATION_ALREADY_COMPOUNDING {#CONSOLIDATION_ALREADY_COMPOUNDING}

A switch to compounding (source = target) for a validator that already has `0x02` credentials.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate) |
| Caller should | drop the request |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">PubkeyDetails</span> |

## Exits {#section-exits}

Every exit error carries `pubkey` where it is about one validator.

All exit errors were plain `Error`s in 2.15. rc.3's `EXIT_SIGNATURE_MALFORMED` is gone: `aggregate` skips a malformed
stored signature like an invalid one.

### EXIT_SHARE_INDEX_INVALID {#EXIT_SHARE_INDEX_INVALID}

`share_idx` outside `1..operators`, or no public share at it for a validator. Fields: `shareIdx`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the payload |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ shareIdx: number; pubkey?: Hex }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_PAYLOAD_SIGNATURE_INVALID {#EXIT_PAYLOAD_SIGNATURE_INVALID}

The payload signature is not 65 bytes, or not by operator `share_idx`'s ENR key over the payload root (partial exits sorted by validator index). Fields: `shareIdx`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the payload |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ shareIdx: number }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_VALIDATOR_NOT_IN_CLUSTER {#EXIT_VALIDATOR_NOT_IN_CLUSTER}

A blob's pubkey is not a validator of the cluster.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the blob |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_VALIDATOR_INDEX_MISMATCH {#EXIT_VALIDATOR_INDEX_MISMATCH}

The blob's `validator_index` differs from the stored exit for the pubkey. Fields: `validatorIndex`, `storedValidatorIndex`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the blob |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex; validatorIndex: string; storedValidatorIndex: string; }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH {#EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

The blob's epoch differs from the stored exit's (rc.3 `EXIT_EPOCH_REGRESSION`, which only refused a lower one). 2.x accepted a higher epoch; v3 does not, since partial signatures over different epochs cannot be aggregated. Fields: `epoch`, `storedEpoch`, `direction` (`higher` or `lower`: the blob's epoch against the stored one; since 3.0.0-rc.12).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the blob. To exit at another epoch the stored exit must be deleted first: each operator that submitted removes its own partial signature (`charon exit delete`, `DELETE /v1/exp/partial_exits/:lockHash/:shareIdx/:pubkey`), and the document goes when none is left; the Obol API has no whole-document delete |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex; epoch: string; storedEpoch: string; direction: 'higher' &#124; 'lower'; }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_SIGNATURE_CONFLICT {#EXIT_SIGNATURE_CONFLICT}

A different partial signature is stored for this share. Fields: `shareIdx`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| Caller should | reject the blob |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex; shareIdx: number }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_PARTIAL_SIGNATURE_INVALID {#EXIT_PARTIAL_SIGNATURE_INVALID}

A partial signature does not verify against the public share, or the aggregate does not verify against the group key (the public shares are not the validator's). Fields: `shareIdx?`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit), [`obol.exits.aggregate`](./reference/exits.md#aggregate) |
| Caller should | reject; for an aggregate, check the public shares |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex; shareIdx?: number }</span> |

</div>

### EXIT_NOT_ENOUGH_SHARES {#EXIT_NOT_ENOUGH_SHARES}

Fewer valid partial signatures than the threshold (malformed or invalid stored ones are left out). Fields: `threshold`, `valid`, `invalid` (share indexes).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.exits.aggregate`](./reference/exits.md#aggregate) |
| Caller should | wait for more operators; re-collect the invalid shares |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ pubkey: Hex; threshold: number; valid: number[]; invalid: number[]; }</span> |

</div>

## Sending {#section-sending}

### PREPARED_INVALID {#PREPARED_INVALID}

`send` or `simulate` got a malformed [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared) (no known `kind`, a malformed `request`, or no `checks` array).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send), [`obol.experimental.simulate`](./reference/experimental.md#simulate) |
| Caller should | pass the value `prepareX` returned |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">Record&lt;string, never&gt;</span> |
| In 2.x | 2.16 `InvalidArgumentError` |

</div>

### FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED {#FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

The prepared transaction (or the simulation passed with it) carries `warning` findings whose codes are not in `acknowledge`; nothing was sent and the wallet was not asked. Fields: `codes` (the distinct codes still to acknowledge), `findings` (the open warnings as [`Finding`](./reference/types/send.md#Finding)s: `code`, `severity`, `message`, `hint?`, `subject?`, `details?`). The message has one numbered line per warning; the hint gives the exact `send(prepared, { acknowledge: [...] })` call and says to show the warnings to whoever owns the funds first. Since 3.0.0-rc.12.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send) |
| Caller should | show each warning (`warningsOf`) to whoever owns the funds; once accepted, pass their codes (`warningCodes(prepared, simulation)`, or a fixed list) in `acknowledge`; there is no boolean or "all" |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ codes: <a href="./reference/types/send#WarningCode">WarningCode</a>[]; findings: Array&lt;<a href="./reference/types/send#Finding">Finding</a>&lt;<a href="./reference/types/send#WarningCode">WarningCode</a>&gt;&gt;; }</span> |
| In 2.x | new |

</div>

### TX_REJECTED {#TX_REJECTED}

The wallet refused or failed before returning a hash; nothing was sent.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send) |
| Caller should | retry if the user wants |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">Record&lt;string, never&gt;</span> |
| In 2.x | new |

</div>

### TX_REVERTED {#TX_REVERTED}

Mined with `status = 0`; nothing moved. Fields: `hash`, `receipt`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send) |
| Caller should | retry is safe; read the revert reason |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ hash: Hash; receipt: TransactionReceipt; contractWallet?: boolean; }</span> |
| In 2.x | `TX_FAILED_AFTER_SEND` with `pendingStatus: "reverted"` |

</div>

### TX_REPLACED {#TX_REPLACED}

A different transaction was mined with the nonce. Fields: `hash`, `reason` (`cancelled` or `replaced`, from viem), `replacement` (its hash). A `repriced` replacement (a speed-up) is not an error: `wait` resolves with its receipt and reports it through `onReplaced`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send) |
| Caller should | retry is safe for this call |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ hash: Hash; reason: 'cancelled' &#124; 'replaced'; replacement: Hash; }</span> |
| In 2.x | new |

</div>

### TX_UNCONFIRMED {#TX_UNCONFIRMED}

No receipt within the timeout (for a contract wallet: no Safe execution log); it may still be mined or executed. Fields: `hash`, `contractWallet`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.send`](./reference/send.md#send) |
| Caller should | watch the hash before retrying, so nothing is sent twice |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ hash: Hash; contractWallet: boolean }</span> |
| In 2.x | `TX_FAILED_AFTER_SEND` with `pendingStatus: "unconfirmed"` |

</div>

### SIMULATION_FAILED {#SIMULATION_FAILED}

The node failed to simulate (a transport error, a block it no longer has state for, an `eth_call` error that is not an execution failure), or a forced `backend` is not supported or fails. A revert is not this error: it is `success: false`. Fields: `backend`.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Thrown by | [`obol.experimental.simulate`](./reference/experimental.md#simulate) |
| Caller should | retry, simulate at the latest block, or use another RPC |
| `details` | <span class="sdk-type">{ backend: string }</span> |
| In 2.x | new |

</div>

## The error classes {#classes}

[`ObolError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolError) has `code`, `message` (not normative), `hint`, `details` and `cause`; [`ObolApiError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolApiError) adds the HTTP fields. Prefer [`isObolError`](./reference/checks.md#isObolError) to `instanceof`: it recognises an error from any copy of the SDK.
